title: A Local AI Lane for Traveling Consultants

slides.title: A Local AI Lane for Traveling Consultants
slides.subtitle: Surface Laptop Ultra with NVIDIA RTX Spark, working alongside Microsoft 365 Copilot
slides.notes: Thank you for your time. The proposal is simple: give traveling consultants a local AI lane on their laptop for sensitive, repeated drafting, while Microsoft 365 Copilot stays exactly where it is. We'll cover the pain, how it works, the capacity at stake, and a small pilot to test it.

slides.title: Summaries Eat Consultant Time
slides.takeaway: Turning interview notes into client summaries is frequent, repeated, and sensitive work.
slides.notes: Start with the consultant's week. Of Contoso's 4,000 employees, 1,200 are traveling consultants. Each writes about 6 client summaries a week, and each takes about 25 minutes to draft today. The inputs are sensitive interview notes and site documents, and the work repeats every week. That's the job a local AI lane targets.

slides.title: Hybrid by Design
slides.takeaway: Microsoft 365 Copilot stays in place; local AI adds a second lane.

data.text: Keep Copilot. Add a local lane.
data.sub: Sensitive, repeated drafting runs on the laptop; everything else stays as today.

slides.notes: This is the heart of the proposal. Microsoft 365 Copilot stays in place for everyday work; nothing is switched off. We add a second lane on the device for a specific job: sensitive, repeated drafting, like turning interview notes into client summaries. Hybrid, not either-or.

slides.title: Like Downloads Before a Flight
slides.takeaway: About 30% of client sites restrict guest Wi-Fi; the model runs on-device.
slides.notes: About 30% of client sites restrict guest Wi-Fi. Think of a long flight: you download shows before boarding, so you can watch without cabin Wi-Fi. Local AI works the same way: 28 models already live on the laptop. Copilot picks up when you're connected, and the pilot validates disconnected use in real conditions.

slides.title: Like the Safe in Your Hotel Room
slides.takeaway: Drafting runs on the laptop, so sensitive client notes needn't leave the device.
slides.notes: Consultants know the hotel safe. Your passport stays in your room; you don't hand it to the front desk. Local AI works the same way: the model runs on the laptop, so interview notes and site documents can be drafted into summaries without uploading them. Copilot, like the concierge, still handles everything else.

slides.title: A Second Lane Beside Copilot
slides.takeaway: Copilot keeps everyday work; sensitive drafting stays inside the laptop boundary.
slides.notes: Here's the architecture at a glance. Everyday Microsoft 365 work keeps flowing through Copilot in the cloud lane, exactly as today. Sensitive, repeated drafting takes the local lane: notes go to a model on the laptop's GPU, and the draft stays on the device. The consultant chooses the lane; the pilot tests that split in practice.

slides.title: Inside the Surface Laptop Ultra
slides.takeaway: An RTX GPU and 128 GB memory run large open models on-device.

slides.notes: Here's what makes it possible. Surface Laptop Ultra pairs 20 CPU cores and 128 GB of installed memory with NVIDIA RTX Spark, a Blackwell RTX GPU. Think of memory as desk space: more room lets bigger models fit. 28 open models are already installed in the local catalog. Consultants only see the top layer: drafting.

slides.title: Fast Enough for Live Drafting
slides.takeaway: Gemma 4 26B generates about 72 tokens per second on this device.
slides.notes: Speed decides whether people actually use it. On this device, Gemma 4 26B generates about 72 tokens per second, and Qwen3-Coder 30B about 86, single stream, per Local-AI-Bench, October 2026. In plain terms, a draft appears while you watch. The pilot shows whether that speed turns into time saved on real summaries.

slides.title: Capacity Math: An Estimate to Test
slides.takeaway: Estimate to validate: 5 minutes saved per summary could mean 27,600 hours yearly.

steps.label: 27,600 hours, estimated
steps.detail: Per year; illustrative estimate to validate

slides.notes: Here's the illustrative math, and it's only an estimate to validate. If a local assistant saved 5 minutes per summary: 1,200 consultants times 6 summaries times 5 minutes times 46 working weeks equals 27,600 hours a year. We're not claiming that number. The pilot measures the real one, so any decision rests on Contoso's own data.

slides.title: The Pilot: 10 Users, 2 Weeks
slides.takeaway: Measure task time, draft quality, user experience, and disconnected use on real work.
slides.notes: The ask is deliberately small: 10 consultants for 2 weeks of real client work. We'll measure task time, draft quality and user experience, and validate disconnected use at sites with restricted Wi-Fi. Copilot stays in place throughout. After 14 days, you decide with Contoso's own numbers, not ours.
